rule: Circle and square always sit at the same height on opposite sides, and the pair moves down step by step (fig2 top, fig3 upper, fig4 middle, so next is low). The circle alternates sides each figure (L,R,L,R so next is left, square right). Vertical bars alternate thick/thin-ish with fig2 thin, so a thin-bar figure is acceptable.
options_check: 1: circle right, square left, heights differ - no. 2: circle right, square left - wrong sides. 3: circle left but square far lower than circle - breaks same-height pairing. 4: circle left but square lower than circle, pair not level - no. 5: circle left, square right, both level and low, continues the downward move - fits.
redraw_diffs: Minor only: line weights and exact positions of circle/square differ slightly (e.g. question fig1 mark heights, answer 3 square sits lower in the original); none change the answer.
